name: gt-engineering
description: Graphictreat engineering workflow skills: per-repo setup, product requirements, issue breakdown, test-driven development, PRD implementation, parallel bug resolution, PRD validation, and senior UI/UX frontend design-taste rules.

interface.shortDescription: Graphictreat per-repo engineering workflow: PRDs, issues, TDD, and delivery
interface.longDescription: End-to-end engineering workflow skills for a repo: bootstrap issue-tracker and domain-doc config (setup-gt-dev-skills), synthesize conversations into PRDs (to-product-req), break plans into tracer-bullet issues (to-issues), build test-first (tdd), implement PRDs branch-by-branch (to-implement-prd), burn down bug backlogs in parallel (resolve-bug-issues), validate shipped work against the PRD (validate-prd-implementation), and apply senior frontend design taste (design-taste-frontend).
defaultPrompt: Let's turn this discussion into a PRD and break it into issues.
